name: HOURSFIRST-the-list-not-folded
note: A handle typed in another case than the list's (a player who wrote TERRA, the list terra) would hold nothing.

name: HOURSFIRST-a-guest-by-its-name
note: A guest whose generated name is a listed handle would wear Hour's First.

name: HOURSFIRST-the-aura-without-the-list
note: Every account would hold The First Hour.

name: HOURSFIRST-another-paint
note: The First Hour's button would wear the Hourbreaker's gold, not its own title's rose gold.

name: HOURSFIRST-the-gradient-turned
note: The word would read from the dawn's white into the rose gold - the light going out.

name: HOURSFIRST-the-hourbreakers-colour
note: Two titles of one colour - a face that draws no gradient could not tell Hour's First from Hourbreaker.

name: HOURSFIRST-the-dial-turning-back
old: turningLook('first', 'FH', FIRST_RGB, { forward: true, blaze: FIRST_BLAZE, rays: FIRST_RAY })
new: turningLook('first', 'FH', FIRST_RGB, { forward: false, blaze: FIRST_BLAZE, rays: FIRST_RAY })
note: The First Hour's dial would turn back as the Remnant's does - the hands never set going again.

name: HOURSFIRST-the-blaze-dropped
old: turningLook('first', 'FH', FIRST_RGB, { forward: true, blaze: FIRST_BLAZE, rays: FIRST_RAY })
new: turningLook('first', 'FH', FIRST_RGB, { forward: true, blaze: 0, rays: FIRST_RAY })
note: The Hour's own mark no brighter than the rest.

name: HOURSFIRST-the-remnants-colours
note: The First Hour would be cast in the Remnant's brass - not a different version.

name: HOURSFIRST-a-name-dropped
note: One of the first clear left out of the title, the aura and the gun.

name: HOURSFIRST-the-rays-dropped
old: { forward: true, blaze: FIRST_BLAZE, rays: FIRST_RAY })
note: AUDIT HOURS-FIRST: the First Hour would be the Remnant's wheel in another colour, turned the other way - the first light's rays are what make it a different version.
